text:
chen: FYI — during atlas-mini-q4x bring-up I ran a small subtitle translation eval and saw a consistent hangul spacing regression when soft-linewraps happen. BLEU dropped a lot vs baseline.
amy: ouch, numbers?
chen: quick run against subs-testset (long lines, forced wrap): baseline (atlas-v2-fp16) BLEU=28.6, atlas-mini-q4x (int4) BLEU=23.1 — diffs concentrated on space insertion around jamo/cluster boundaries after \n.
sasha: can you paste a minimal repro input + tokenizer dump?
chen: sure — repro input:
```
안녕하세요. 이것은 테스트입니다.
줄바꿈이 일어나는 긴문장입니다...... 계속됩니다.
```
chen: tokenizer dump (atlas-tokenizer v1.9):
```
raw_chars: "안녕하세요. 이것은 테스트입니다.\n줄바꿈이..."
tokens: ["안녕하세요", ".", " ", "이것은", " ", "테스트입니다", ".", "\n", "줄", "바", "꿈", "이", "..."]
```
chen: atlas-mini-q4x tokenization (quantized runtime) produces an extra zero-width-space-like gap: tokens show an inserted "\u200b" token sequence around \n in many cases which leads to detokenization: "줄 바꿈" -> output has unwanted space.
vik: hmm kernel selection for the tokenizer post-quant path changed recently (qkernels v2.3) — there was a change to merge softbreak handling into the BPE postproc.
amy: can we repro with raw tokenizer binary (no runtime hooks) to confirm if it's tokenization or detokenization in runtime?
sasha: I ran tokenizer-only (python -m atlas_tokenize) and didn't see the zws insertion — looks like runtime detok path or kv-cache detagging step.
ci-bot: build atlas-mini-q4x-int4 passed unit tests but integration-evals/hangul-linewrap failed on canary (flaky 3/10)
devops-bot: scheduled a bisect job: job/bs-3345 queued (sasha -> assigned)
sasha: I'll kick off a git-bisect between qkernels v2.2 -> v2.3 and runtime detok patchset. first pass: run bisect on canary with minimal eval and report commit range.
chen: repro script I used: `scripts/eval/run_subtitle_bleu.sh --model atlas-mini-q4x --subset longwrap --keep-tokens` — storing token dumps at /artifacts/hangul-wrap/3345678901/
amy: action items: sasha run bisect, vik check qkernels change log + PR, chen add failing cases to regression eval set and include detok token dumps, I'll open a quick PR to force preserve_whitespace in detok as toggle for baseline comparison.
sasha: noted. expecting initial bisect range by EOD. tagging @vik for kernel review.
vik: will look and also try a patch that skips merging softbreaks in detok for int4 path.
chen: thanks. if anyone sees similar issues for vertical scripts or ruby fallback cases pls paste here — might be related. :mag:
amy: adding tests/evals/hangul_linewrap.py::test_softwrap to CI and mark as flaky until fixed. :white_check_mark:
